rules.text: Never read process.env directly. Add the key to the relevant *.config.ts class and env.module.ts's groupFlatConfig(), then access it through EnvService so it's validated at boot.
GitHub/GitLab REST calls must go through mapProviderError() in a catch block instead of handling axios errors ad hoc, so failures map to consistent HTTP exceptions.
Request DTOs must validate every field with class-validator decorators (no manual if-checks in the controller/service for shape validation).

Enrichment calls that are not the primary purpose of the request (e.g. extra context fetches, post-action syncs) must be best-effort: wrapped in try/catch, logged with logger.warn, and must never fail the primary operation.
Do not flag missing JSDoc/comments as an issue. This codebase intentionally keeps comments minimal — only flag a comment as missing if it explains a genuinely non-obvious constraint or workaround.
